author: edwong57
body:
Following https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32838 (PR https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/pull/32963), GO:0042903 tubulin deacetylase activity is now mechanism-neutral, and has two new children, following the same split as histone deacetylase activity (GO:0141221 hydrolytic / GO:0017136 NAD-dependent):

GO:0170088 | tubulin deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism (Zn2+-dependent HDACs, e.g. HDAC6; RHEA:21548)
GO:0170089 | tubulin deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent (sirtuins, e.g. SIRT2)

GO:0042903 is not being obsoleted and existing annotations remain valid, but where the enzyme family is known please move them to the appropriate child.

- No InterPro2GO, EC, Rhea or UniRule mappings to GO:0042903.
title: Review annotations to GO:0042903 tubulin deacetylase activity: move to the mechanism-specific children (go-ontology#32838)
